notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR19: for the SORT or MERGE reference to procedure-name-1 in its INPUT or OUTPUT phrase, DEBUG-LINE the statement and DEBUG-CONTENTS 'SORT INPUT', 'SORT OUTPUT' or 'MERGE OUTPUT'. SortEmitter.EmitSort/EmitMerge set the cause and the statement's line (EmitDebugCause) before the implicit transfer, and __RunDebug renders DebugItem.ContentsFor. Probes: witness matches; d6 (MERGE OUTPUT PROCEDURE MO: MERGE OUTPUT line 34; SORT INPUT IP-A THRU IP-B: IP-A SORT INPUT line 36, IP-B FALL THROUGH (GR22); paragraph OUTPUT subject: SORT OUTPUT line 36; sequential USING files); 2002/2023 COBOL0902. Its GO TO MO-1 loop re-running section MO is the GR3 defect.
